vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A published CVE is a present risk; the cooldown exists to catch a hypothetical compromised release. Security updates therefore skip the age gate and the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Most open alerts are transitive dependencies in ui/pnpm-lock.yaml and Cargo.lock, which no direct-dependency bump reaches. Automerged because the build-rust and build-ui jobs compile from the refreshed lock files.
